selection: Every two-club MLB trade announced from the day after the previous World Series through the day before North American Opening Day. Excluded when it involves three or more clubs, a player to be named later, cash with no reported amount, international bonus pool space, a draft pick outside Competitive Balance Round B, or a minor leaguer with no FanGraphs FV published on or before the trade date. Rule fixed before any trade was scored.
searched_sources: Baseball-Reference 2026 transactions log (https://www.baseball-reference.com/leagues/majors/2026-transactions.shtml): every January, February and March 2026 entry that mentions 'traded' or 'purchased'.
Baseball-Reference 2026 transactions page (covers Nov 2025 to Mar 2026), November and December 2025 entries: https://www.baseball-reference.com/leagues/MLB/2026-transactions.shtml
ESPN MLB transactions API, November 2025 and December 2025: https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/baseball/mlb/transactions?dates=202511 and dates=202512

FanGraphs blogs (blogs.fangraphs.com WordPress API): every 'Prospect List' team list from 2024-10 to 2026-03-24, 2025 Top 100 and updates (03-31, 07-29, 10-03), the 2026 Top 100, the 2025 deadline traded-prospect ranking, the 2025 Draft day-one recap, trade write-ups, and a name search for each traded minor leaguer. FanGraphs' The Board could not be read (Cloudflare challenge), so 'no FV' means none was found in published FanGraphs articles.

FanGraphs grades: blogs.fangraphs.com WordPress search API by player name, limited to posts on or before each trade date (team prospect lists, Top 100 updates, trade write-ups, Rule 5 scouting article)

MLB Stats API January to mid-February 2026 trades, checked only to confirm that Edward Cabrera, Josh Lowe, Brendan Donovan, Nolan Arenado, Caleb Durbin, Eric Wagaman and similar deals fall outside the window
MLB Stats API schedule: the first 2026 regular-season game was Yankees at Giants on 2026-03-25 (Oracle Park), so the window ends 2026-03-24.

MLB Stats API transactions, 2026-01-01 to 2026-03-24, all sports levels (statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/transactions); every TR record reviewed, plus 2026-03-25 to 04-02 and 2025-12-28 to 12-31 to check the edges. Three TR records (2026-01-10, 2026-01-13, 2026-02-03) have no person or description and match no reported trade.

MLB Stats API transactions, typeCode TR, 2025-11-02 to 2025-12-31: sportId=1 (108 trade rows), no sport filter (141 rows; the extras are winter-league trades plus three rows with no description dated 2025-11-13, 2025-12-09 and 2025-12-16), minor-league sportIds 11-14, 16 (no extra MLB-club trades). https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/transactions?startDate=2025-11-02&endDate=2025-12-31
MLB Trade Rumors monthly archives (https://www.mlbtraderumors.com/2026/01, /2026/02, /2026/03; every page): all post titles scanned for acquire/trade/swap/purchase/PTBNL.
MLB Trade Rumors posts (via web.archive.org) for trade terms, contracts and cash; MLB.com news articles for the Nimmo/Semien cash

MLB.com 2025-26 offseason transaction tracker (undated team-by-team list, used to confirm deals and three-team structures): https://www.mlb.com/news/mlb-2025-2026-free-agents-trades-offseason-transaction-tracker
Service time and contract status from Baseball-Reference player pages ('Service Time (01/2026)'); 2026 arbitration agreements from the MLB Trade Rumors 2026 Arbitration Tracker (2026-01-08).
Service time and contracts: Baseball-Reference player pages (Service Time (01/2026)), MLBTR 2026 arbitration tracker for agreement dates
Spot checks of MLB.com and AP reports for the Durbin pick, the Teng bonus pool money, the Woodford cash and the Peralta option.
